determinism_gate.expectation: run A and run B translations byte-identical for all 20 intents
determinism_gate.scope_note: This measures the literal translator only. It shows that the repository's earlier deterministic-rerun guarantees cannot be assumed to extend to Ollama generation in general. It is not evidence about the G0 English generator, which would need its own test.

human_adjudication.byte_note: Hashed exactly as saved by the reviewer, UTF-8 BOM included; the file is never rewritten.

overall_result.rule: primary gate is the conjunction of G1 and G2
